pages.text: I am small and exceptionally light, with only six hearts of vitality. I move about forty-five percent faster than an ordinary person, descend slowly through the air, and cannot bear heavy armor.$(br2)Bright surroundings restore my body, though the process consumes hunger.

My diet is fibrous rather than ordinary food.$(br2)While airborne, $(bold)Space$() gives me one of six powerful wingbeats; touching the ground restores them. $(bold)V$() begins a dive, and striking a creature during it adds five damage and throws me upward again.$(br2)$(bold)N$() produces my natural cry. I feel no understood mana art within $(bold)G$() yet.
pages.title: Abilities and Instincts
